resolved_development_failures: The first end-to-end export fixture found that JSON stringifies integer configuration keys while tensor checkpoint metadata preserves their types. Metadata is now normalized at the JSON boundary before hashing and sharding; selected-export generation and resumed updates pass.
CUDA device access was unavailable inside the sandbox. The tiny test passed with direct device access; the full offline CPU suite intentionally skips both optional CUDA tests.
limitations: The 1,000-update curriculum and four-pass decode are explicit prototype settings, not measured optima or proof of sufficient adaptation data.
No full-8B Spark training, activation/kernel/recovery feasibility, learning-quality or speedup claim is supported.
Selection CE is a masked-block objective, not comparable AR perplexity. Locked-test token exact match does not establish semantic correctness.
Whole-group/overlap checks cover supplied sealed sources only; broader contamination is unknown.
Memory and disk admission use meta arithmetic and declared reserves; write accounting is conservative logical I/O rather than physical device wear.
